scope: UI-kit inventory readiness for general website content; read-only review, no implementation changes

steps.name: Kit coverage and source inventory
steps.health: Strong event UI foundation; incomplete general content and asynchronous feedback coverage
strengths: Consistent theme tokens and shared controls
Existing badges, notices, empty results, missing-photo, cancellation, sold-out, retry and unavailable-event specimens
Documented component ownership and extension conventions
gaps: No scoped prose component for ordinary CMS/WYSIWYG HTML
No general informational-page shell or public footer pattern
Table styling exists only in documentation CSS, not product CSS; ordinary article media needs a reusable treatment
Inline form errors exist, but no error-summary and complete pending/success/failure behavior contract
No complete loading/progress, offline or site-wide recovery page patterns
Collection pagination or load-more contract remains conditional on real dataset needs
accessibilityRisks: Rich HTML needs deliberate heading, link, list and table semantics alongside styling
Dynamic pending, success and failure feedback needs documented focus and announcement behavior
evidenceLimits: Screenshot establishes current coverage presentation; absence findings also rely on reviewed manifest, templates and product CSS
This is an inventory check, not a full keyboard, screen-reader or cross-browser accessibility audit
No policy content or backend functionality assessed

recommendedNextPass: Scoped prose plus a general content-page shell first; then complete feedback and recovery patterns using existing components.
